children: posted a 58% rise in second-quarter profit on Thursday, helped by higher trading volumes due to a steady growth in users.
India's stock market has seen a surge in retail investors as millions of first-time traders use cheap brokerage apps, digital payments and benefit from easier opening of online accounts.
Angel One's client base grew 17.3% to 39.98 million in September, the brokerage said in an exchange filing earlier this month.
It posted a quarterly consolidated profit of 3.35 billion rupees ($35.24 million) in the quarter ended September 30, up from 2.12 billion rupees a year earlier.
Analysts, on average, expected a profit of 3.33 billion rupees, according to data compiled by LSEG.
The company's revenue from operations rose nearly 19% to 14.27 billion rupees, above estimates of 12.20 billion rupees.
